hold_reason: Refund for order 243 (amount_cents 13498) was requested in this batch but is not in the refunds table. list_refunds shows only order 240 (8145) and order 245 (10428), both matching. W2 also reported only those two as applied. No payouts have been recorded. Needs human review of order 243 before the batch proceeds.

reply.thought: The handoff lists three refunds requested in the batch, but W2 reported only two as applied, and order 243 is missing. I need to check the refunds table before recording any payout, so I'll start with list_refunds.

The refunds table has 240 and 245 with matching amounts, but order 243 (13498 cents) requested in this batch is missing. The rules say to hold rather than record any payout when a requested refund is missing, so I'll stop the batch for review.
